---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe the situation you're in — what are you trying to do with
PayloadLens that isn't possible (or is awkward) today?

## Proposed solution

What would you like PayloadLens to do instead? If you have a specific idea
for the configuration attribute, API shape, or UI behavior, describe it
here.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you've thought about, and why they fall short.

## Security/masking impact

Does this feature touch what data is rendered, masked, or exposed via the
JavaScript API? If so, please describe how it interacts with the masking
model in [docs/masking.md](../../docs/masking.md) and the rendering-safety
guarantees in [docs/security.md](../../docs/security.md) — features in this
area get extra scrutiny before being accepted.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps evaluate the request.
